name: Satoru
source:
An ungodly studious bookworm.

This young man entered the school together with the heroine. A neurotic for studying, he doesn't care what this place is and only continues to study. Not used to communicating with humans, whenever someone talks to him he shows his wariness like a cat bristling its fur.

[From [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2015/05/10/bad-apple-wars/]Otome Jikan[/url]]

[spoiler]His full name is Kuragari Satoru (暮明 覚).[/spoiler]
